text:
maria: seeing ~20 gpu nodes stuck in `joining` in usw2. allocator: "kms rpc error: connection refused"
ben: looks like new egress baseline blocked 10.200.0.0/16. internal-kms sits at 10.200.5.19.
chia: that explains disk-decrypt failures. nodes can't unwrap CMKs during boot.
maria: need fast mitigation so we don't burn reserved GPUs. options?
security: provisional approve a 20m, scoped egress allow from sg=compute-warmup to 10.200.5.19:443. Must include audit note + owner.
chia: creating PR infra/egress-allow-kms-hotpatch with minimal rule. snippet:
```hcl
# temp allow for node decrypt during onboarding
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "egress_allow_kms_temp" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.200.5.19/32"]
  description       = "TEMP allow to internal-kms for node decrypt - 20m"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
}
```
deploy-bot: apply started infra/egress-allow-kms-hotpatch at 1867894350 by chia
infra-bot: canary result: 3/3 nodes warmed at 1867894375
ben: rolling to 25 -> 50 nodes. monitor billing dashboard for idle cost.
security: audit logged: temporary rule approved by (maria/ben/chia). TTL 20m. Follow-ups required: 1) add internal-kms to approved egress proxy, 2) document exception process, 3) add decrypt e2e tests.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/egress-allow-kms-hotpatch completed at 1867894388 by chia
maria: opening infra#4701 to implement proxy/nat path and close loop on exception docs. Closing alert. Thanks all :thumbsup:
